import pandas as pd

def load(sheet):
    df = pd.read_excel('DonHang_ChiTiet.xlsx', sheet_name=sheet, usecols='A:I')
    df.columns = ['ma','ngay','trang_thai','khach','san_pham','so_luong','gia','tong_tien','don_vi']
    df['tong_tien'] = df['tong_tien'].astype(str).str.replace('.', '', regex=False).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(int)
    return df

for s in ['T10_2025','T11_2025']:
    df = load(s)
    rev = df[df['trang_thai'].isin(['Đã hoàn thành'])]['tong_tien'].sum()
    print(s, "revenue (completed only):", rev)

# Note: rulebook says revenue includes "đang giao" (in progress) but not cancelled/returned.
# Here only "Đã hoàn thành" exists (no "đang giao"), so completed = revenue.
